facts.fact: UIDAI's Biometric Lock/Unlock service lets the Aadhaar holder lock their biometrics and unlock them temporarily
facts.quote: Biometric Locking/Unlocking is a service that allows an Aadhaar holder to lock and temporarily unlock their biometrics.

facts.fact: While locked, fingerprints, iris and face cannot be used for any Aadhaar authentication by anyone
facts.quote: Locked Biometrics confirms that Aadhaar holder will not be able to use Biometrics (fingerprints/iris/Face) for authentication, it is a safety feature to stop any kind of biometric authentication.

facts.fact: The Aadhaar app offers biometric lock/unlock
facts.quote: Presently, the Aadhaar app offers various services like - Mobile Number Update, Address Update, Biometric lock/unlock, Selective Sharing of Aadhaar Verifiable Credential, check Authentication History, download e-Aadhaar, share Contact Card, Track my request, etc.

facts.fact: Biometrics can be unlocked on the UIDAI website (myAadhaar), at an enrolment centre / Aadhaar Seva Kendra, or in the Aadhaar app
facts.quote: The biometric unlock can be done by Aadhaar number holder either by visiting UIDAI website, enrolment centre, Aadhaar Seva Kendra(ASK), through Aadhaar app.

facts.fact: A mobile number registered with Aadhaar is needed to use the service
facts.quote: Note: Registered Mobile Number is essential to avail this service. In case your mobile number is not registered with Aadhaar visit the nearest Enrolment Centre/Mobile Update End Point.

behaviour: Explains biometric lock and temporary unlock via the UIDAI website (myAadhaar) or the Aadhaar app as published by UIDAI, citing uidai.gov.in for every step; does not ask for the user's Aadhaar number or OTP.
fail_if: It gives steps or channels not on UIDAI pages, says biometrics cannot be unlocked, or asks for the Aadhaar number or OTP.
summary: Added from UIDAI FAQs: lock and temporary unlock, effect of the lock, Aadhaar app lock/unlock, unlock channels (UIDAI website, centre/ASK, app), registered mobile needed.
